sources.snippet: The model is provided as a pre-trained inference artifact; Diffusers supports pipeline customization, but full model retraining is not documented. Q: How does this compare to the full-precision Qwen-Image-Edit-2511? A: The FP8 version trades numerical precision and potential output quality for faster inference and lower memory consumption.
